reply:
2^53 - 1 is `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`. 2^53 itself is representable exactly in JavaScript, but 2^53 + 1 rounds to 2^53, so 2^53 is where the collision starts.

The distinction: MAX_SAFE_INTEGER is the largest integer where all integers below it are also distinctly representable. 2^53 can still be represented exactly, but you lose the guarantee that adjacent integers are distinct.
